control_scenario.description: B2 on uniform load (benchmarks/bench_compare_uniform.py): tokenizer openai-community/gpt2 @607a30d7, holdout schema big_enum_64, shared trace = canonical BPE tokenization of the document {"symbol":"sym_42","weight":0.5} (acceptance of every token confirmed by accept/consume on all three engines), >= 10000 warm fill_mask observations per engine, seed 42, warmup of 3 traces
control_scenario.primary_metric: p99 of fill_mask mask construction time on the shared trace
control_scenario.observation_rule: Review f721568: p99 of every class involved in the decision is backed by enough observations - mask/accept/warm compile at ≥10000 warm per class (SPEC §10.5), cold compile/first mask/tokenizer prepare at ≥30 independent repeats (cold start, SPEC §10.5), B1 - ≥30 processes. Fewer - INCONCLUSIVE, not a silent GO.
control_scenario.go_rule: Single criterion (review R7+A5+817c860, tightened by review f721568 and 2040396): the primary metric is single and pinned - p99(fill_mask) of zig_adaptive at least 20% below the best of {xgrammar 0.2.6, llguidance 1.8.0} on that metric. In addition, all other measured latencies (p50/p95/p99 fill_mask, p50/p95/p99 accept_token, cold compile, warm compile, first mask) must be no worse than +10% relative to the same competitor (otherwise FAIL, not a switch to another option); the B7 e2e guard with the full matrix and the secondary holdout corpus are mandatory (secondary_guard, item 5 of review 817c860). The comparison is conservative: zig - worst source, competitor - best, across ALL collections (review 2040396 D2 - collections are merged, none is dropped). An error/invalid mandatory run (including summary={status:ERROR} without total_s - structural NO-GO), an incomplete matrix, insufficient repeats/observations (of every present source, review 2040396 D3) or B1 with fewer than 30 processes block GO; missing data - INCONCLUSIVE. B1 memory is published as an additional fact and provides no bypass to GO. Under the active v3 protocol (acceptance_protocol_v3) additionally: the e2e guard is decided by the median of paired block ratios (same +5% threshold), the first mask - from ≥1000 cold observations per engine/collection, collection composition and revision identity are checked by the gate before the decision.

e2e_guard.description: B7 (benchmarks/bench_e2e_constrained.py): median request-time regression of zig_constrained vs xgrammar_constrained at most 5% on the full matrix. The protocol is pinned (review 817c860): each schema is warmed with one generation on EACH engine before the scored repeats, the first request of each engine is published separately (warmups field), engines alternate within a repeat, 4 repeats per file by default; the first-repeat spike (core mask cache misses / xgrammar cold compilation) was measured separately and does not enter the verdict.

secondary_guard.description: Item 5 of review 817c860: independent generalization check on a PREVIOUSLY UNUSED holdout. acceptance_protocol.fixed_at: 2026-09-19, before the eighth run (review 2040396 D2); thresholds 20%/10%/5% unchanged
acceptance_protocol.merge_rule: Both collections of the same code are merged WITHOUT dropping: uniform (primary scenario and secondary holdout) - worst zig / best competitor over all present sources of both collections; e2e - pool of all repeats of both collections with medians over repeats; B1 (≥30 processes) is checked in each collection; B3/B5/B6/B8/GPU are published for each collection.
acceptance_protocol.rejection_rule: A collection is not dropped based on measurement results. Objective rejection is structural only: status != OK of a mandatory file in any collection → NO-GO; missing mandatory files / insufficient observations / repeats → INCONCLUSIVE. Machine conditions are recorded in environment.txt of each collection and published; a conditions anomaly does not reject a collection by itself - it is absorbed by the conservative merge.
acceptance_protocol.environment_capture: each collection saves environment.txt (loadavg 1/5/15, MemAvailable, uptime, uname, date); values are compared between collections in REPORT.
acceptance_protocol.e2e_variance: medians of total_s over all repeats of both collections; worst zig / best competitor over repeats are published; the 5% threshold applies to the pool medians.

acceptance_protocol_v2.fixed_at: 2026-09-19, before the ninth run (review 2040396 D2; after the eighth-run NO-GO and diagnostics: s1 b8 flaps with isolated transient machine windows of +2..+20% on zig repeats - VS Code background, spikes demonstrated outside the scored CPU phases; the median of two collections is sensitive to such windows)
acceptance_protocol_v2.merge_rule: Same rules as in acceptance_protocol: collections of the same code are merged WITHOUT dropping - uniform (primary scenario and secondary holdout) over all present sources: zig - worst, competitor - best; e2e - pool of all repeats of all collections with medians; B1 (>=30 processes) is checked in EACH collection; B3/B5/B6/B8/GPU are published for each collection.
acceptance_protocol_v2.rejection_rule: Same objective rejection as in acceptance_protocol: a collection is not dropped based on measurement results; status != OK of a mandatory file in any collection -> NO-GO; missing mandatory files / insufficient observations / repeats -> INCONCLUSIVE. Machine conditions (loadavg 1/5/15, MemAvailable, uptime, uname, date) are recorded in environment.txt of each collection and published.
acceptance_protocol_v2.e2e_variance: medians of total_s over repeats of all three collections (pool of 24 repeats per configuration); worst zig / best competitor over repeats are published; the 5% threshold applies to the pool medians.
acceptance_protocol_v2.rationale: the number of collections was increased 2 -> 3 IN ADVANCE for robustness of the merged median against transient machine windows: in the eighth run a window affected 2 of 4 e2e files and shifted the s1 b8 pool median (+6.9%); with 24 repeats a window affecting <=2 of 6 files does not push the median over the threshold. Merge rules, rejection rules and thresholds 20%/10%/5% unchanged.
acceptance_protocol_v2.code_change: s1-hotpath wave: hot-path fusion in the HF adapter - unpack writes the FORBIDDEN bits with a single eq straight into a persistent buffer (fast path of all active rows: no logical_not_, no mask row copy, no per-step allocations; partial path: same cached buffer); regression unpack_forbid == ~unpack. The core was not changed.

acceptance_protocol_v3.fixed_at: 2026-09-19T09:28:45Z, before the tenth run (review 4bf4ada E1-E3, item 5); thresholds 20%/10%/5% unchanged; pinned by a commit BEFORE the first measurement - collections run on the committed bytes, revision is recorded in environment.txt of each collection
acceptance_protocol_v3.identity_rule: The gate requires identical commit, protocol, protocol_sha256 (canonical sha256 of the protocol spec) and sources_sha256 (combined sha256 of the core/adapter/benchmark sources) in environment.txt of each collection; a difference or a missing field - INCONCLUSIVE (exit 2), GO impossible.
acceptance_protocol_v3.composition_rule: The gate requires exactly runs unique collections with run_tags (uniqueness of canonical paths). A missing, repeated (same directory twice) or extraneous collection - INCONCLUSIVE (exit 2), GO impossible. A single directory - single-collection analysis mode (exit 3), explicitly marked as NOT acceptance.

uniform_requirements.cold_state: new bundle (use_cache=False) + new engine + compile + first fill_mask; without warmup; run_all passes --repeats 1000 to both uniform runs (primary and secondary); p99 = 10th largest of 1000 observations per engine/collection/file (review 4bf4ada item 5.2/5.4: with n=30 p99 is effectively the sample maximum)
uniform_requirements.parameters_check: the gate verifies the protocol block of each uniform file (cold_repeats>=1000, min_observations>=10000, min_warm_observations>=10000) and the length of raw observations

e2e_requirements.margin_rule: The decision is made on the point estimate: median of paired zig/xg ratios (block = file x repeat; on even repeats zig runs first, on odd repeats - xgrammar; the order is recorded in the order_pos field). The +5% threshold is unchanged. If the median <= 1.05 but the upper bound of the 95% bootstrap CI > 1.05, the case is marked margin and does NOT change the verdict (rule pinned in advance). Absolute pool medians are published for comparability, but the decision is not made on them.

acceptance_protocol_v3.merge_rule: Collections of the same code are merged WITHOUT dropping: uniform (primary scenario and secondary holdout) - worst zig / best competitor over all valid sources; e2e - paired ratios within blocks of all collections (median and CI), pool medians are published; B1 (>=30 processes) is checked in EACH collection; B3/B5/B6/B8/GPU are published for each collection.
acceptance_protocol_v3.rejection_rule: Objective rejection is structural: status != OK or a corrupted mandatory file in any collection -> NO-GO; missing files / insufficient observations / incomplete paired blocks / repeats -> INCONCLUSIVE; an incomplete source is EXCLUDED from the number comparison (does not participate in the merge) and cannot yield GO. A collection is not dropped based on measurement results.
acceptance_protocol_v3.rationale: Review 4bf4ada: (1) the gate did not check the v2 composition - now it does; single-collection analysis is separated from acceptance (exit 3); (2) an incomplete uniform with null p99 broke the summary - now a structured INCONCLUSIVE, the source is excluded; status=ERROR of a mandatory file - NO-GO in both the primary uniform and B1, as the published rule promises; (3) e2e compares engines within time blocks with balanced AB/BA order (removes systematic order asymmetry and inter-process drift in the pool median); the first mask gets 1000 cold observations, p99 stops being the sample maximum. Thresholds 20%/10%/5% unchanged; the ninth NO-GO remains a historical fact, the v3 methodology is not applied to past data retroactively.
acceptance_protocol_v3.code_change: Gate fixes (4bf4ada E1/E2), balanced AB/BA and blocks in bench_e2e_constrained.py, 1000 cold repeats and the protocol block in bench_compare_uniform.py (via run_all), new benchmarks/capture_environment.py; the core and HF adapter were not changed.
